services.name: Cabanas
services.desc: Make the most of your next sun-soaked adventure by renting a cabana - the ultimate way to relax and unwind in style! Cabanas typically provide a covered area where you can relax, eat and enjoy the company of friends and family members without the prying eyes of others nearby. This ensures that you may enjoy yourself without worrying about being interrupted or disturbed by others. Dedicated cabana attendants to ensure a comfortable and delightful experience for

gap: Duration not stated for some rentals (tandem kayak, sailboat, Duffy boat)
blurb: Guests enjoy full-day admission to a lagoon with included access to bumper boats and the largest aqua course in Texas. Additional watercraft rentals and private cabanas are available. The park operates with limited daily capacity and requires advance online ticket purchase.
extraNote: Tickets must be purchased online in advance; gate tickets only if capacity not reached · No re-entry once exited park grounds · No outside food, beverages, or coolers allowed except for medical/dietary needs · Park remains open on most rainy days; full day closure due to severe weather results in rain check ticket valid for current season · Admission tickets and rentals are non-refundable and non-transferable except for inclement weather policy · Lagoonfest Texas is cash-free; accepts major credit/debit cards and mobile payments · Summer 2026
